Paid engagements

Start focused. Expand when it proves useful.

01 · FIXED-SCOPE REVIEW

Architecture review

Assess one application or platform boundary before a build, migration, or redesign.

Includes a system and dependency diagram, five prioritized findings, a 90-day roadmap, and a findings meeting. A typical review takes about two weeks once agreed inputs are available.

Commercial model: fixed project fee agreed in a proposal.

Request a review proposal →
02 · DEFINED DELIVERY

Implementation sprint

Address one agreed priority from an architecture review or an already-understood project.

Agree the target outcome, boundaries, milestones, and handover up front. Production changes and ongoing support are separately scoped.

Commercial model: scoped project fee agreed before delivery.

Discuss an implementation sprint →
03 · MONTHLY GUIDANCE

Fractional architecture guidance

Recurring design reviews, engineering mentorship, and technical decision support without a full-time leadership commitment.

Set a monthly cadence, available capacity, priorities, and decision records around your team’s needs.

Commercial model: monthly fee and service boundaries agreed in writing.

Discuss monthly guidance →
04 · PAID MSP PILOT

Monthly IT reporting

Test one client-reporting workflow using an agreed ticket export and monitoring summary.

The paid pilot covers one input format and one report template. Your team reviews the facts and approves any report before sharing. No direct integrations are required for the pilot.

Commercial model: fixed pilot fee; if useful, separately scoped setup and monthly reporting fees based on agreed volume and support.
